newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat up sharply on fund buying, export hopes.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat up sharply on fund buying, export hopes.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures were up sharply on talk that Egypt may buy 500,000 to one million tonnes of U.S. wheat this weekend for September through October shipment, traders said.
"There's export demand for wheat and Egypt could buy more Friday. They're tendering for 50,000 tonnes European but they could buy a lot more," a trader said.
Egypt this week bought U.S. wheat and U.S. exporters early Wednesday said Jordan bought 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat.
Fund buying centered on bidding by Prudential Securities for the September contract, traders said.
September and December was in fast trading and technicians Tuesday said the market was giving off bullish technical signals.
At 1035 CDT, CBOT soft red winter wheat was 5-1/4 to nine cents per bushel higher, with September up 7-3/4 at $3.57-1/2. December was up 8-3/4 cents at $3.72.
